metadata: {"id":"anti-snipe","name":"Anti-snipe","contract":"AntiSnipeModule","category":"protection","line":"Caps buys per block and taxes bots at the pool open.","detail":"For a window after the pool opens, buys share a per-block cap and pay a snipe tax. The tax goes into the pool's Nth-buy pot if it has one, else its last-buyer pot, else the protocol. Nobody else can add liquidity during the window. Sells are never touched. The curve phase has its own guard in the launch settings. Pool only: the curve has its own guard in the launch settings.","capabilities":["beforeSwap","liquidity"],"conflictGroups":[],"needsRouter":false,"phase":"pool","config":{"abi":"(uint32 guardBlocks,uint96 maxBuyPerBlock,uint16 snipeTaxBps)","params":[{"key":"guardBlocks","label":"Window (blocks)","type":"uint32","unit":"blocks","min":1,"max":7200,"default":150,"step":1},{"key":"maxBuyPerBlock","label":"Cap per block (0 = none)","type":"uint96","unit":"quote","min":"0","defaultUsd":50,"zeroAllowed":true,"step":0.5},{"key":"snipeTaxBps","label":"Snipe tax (%)","type":"uint16","unit":"bps","min":0,"max":2500,"default":1500,"step":0.5}]},"views":{"guardActive":"guardActive(bytes32 poolId) returns (bool)","guardOf":"guardOf(bytes32 poolId) returns (tuple)"},"events":["SnipeTax(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed to, uint256 amount)"],"v1Block":"antiSnipe","notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (as config/hookBlocks.ts). {"id":"beacon","name":"Beacon","contract":"BeaconModule","category":"linked","line":"Records the token's all-time-high market cap so other tokens can react to it.","detail":"Keeps the token's highest US-dollar market cap on-chain, for Entangled tokens that unlock when this one reaches a target. Curve and pool prices both count. A price only counts once it has lasted into a later block, so a pump and dump inside one block never registers. It changes nothing about trading and takes no fees. A new high only counts once the market cap has held for at least 15 minutes across 5 or more blocks (the recorded high is the lowest value seen during that stretch).","capabilities":["beforeSwap"],"conflictGroups":[],"needsRouter":false,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"()","params":[]},"views":{"athUsd":"athUsd(address token) returns (uint256)","beacon":"beacon(address token) returns (uint256 usd, uint256 at, bool registered)"},"events":["NewHigh(address indexed token, uint256 mcUsd, uint256 timestamp)"],"notes":"No parameters: the config is empty bytes. athUsd has 18 decimals."}

{"id":"breathing-cap","name":"Breathing cap","contract":"BreathingCapModule","category":"buy-cap","line":"The max buy breathes in and out on a fixed clock.","detail":"The largest buy allowed follows a sine wave from launch (bonding-curve buys are capped too): it starts at the average cap, rises by the swing a quarter cycle later, falls by the swing three quarters in, and repeats. It never drops below the floor. It counts tokens received by all buys in one transaction together, from any route. Sells are never capped.","capabilities":["afterSwap"],"conflictGroups":["buyCap"],"needsRouter":false,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"(uint16 baseBps,uint16 swingBps,uint16 floorBps,uint32 cycle)","params":[{"key":"baseBps","label":"Average max per buy (% of supply)","type":"uint16","unit":"supplyBps","min":10,"max":1000,"default":100,"step":0.01},{"key":"swingBps","label":"Swing (± % of the average)","type":"uint16","unit":"bps","min":100,"max":10000,"default":6000,"step":1},{"key":"floorBps","label":"Never below (% of supply)","type":"uint16","unit":"supplyBps","min":1,"max":1000,"default":10,"step":0.01,"help":"At most the average cap."},{"key":"cycle","label":"One breath (minutes)","type":"uint32","unit":"minutes","min":60,"max":604800,"default":300,"step":1}]},"views":{"currentCap":"currentCap(address token) returns (uint256)","capAt":"capAt(address token, uint256 ts) returns (uint256)"},"errors":["BuyCapExceeded(uint256 bought, uint256 cap)"],"notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (see config/hookModules.ts ParamUnit). Caps are in tokens (18 decimals)."}

{"id":"buyback","name":"Buyback & burn","contract":"BuybackModule","category":"rewards","line":"Sells fund buybacks that burn the token.","detail":"A share of what every sell pays out is saved. Module buy-side credits of a pool together are capped by the core at 25% of a buy (MAX_MODULE_CUT_BPS): the UI must keep the sum of snipe tax, pot shares, LP rewards, referral fee and King fee under it, or guarded buys revert."}

{"id":"buyer-rewards","name":"Buyer rewards","contract":"BuyerRewardsModule","category":"rewards","line":"Every qualifying buy earns a fixed reward from a vault you fill.","detail":"You stock a vault with any ERC-20 token. Every bonding-curve buy, and every pool buy through the AvaxHook router, of at least the minimum earns the buyer a fixed reward, up to a set number of rewarded buys per wallet. Earned rewards are reserved for the buyer, who claims them any time. When the vault runs dry, buys stop earning until it is topped up (anyone may top it up). You can withdraw only what nobody has earned. The creator's own buys don't earn, and aggregator buys can't be attributed so they don't either. Each reward stays locked for the lock period after the wallet's latest qualifying buy; selling or sending any of the token during that time forfeits the locked rewards back to the vault, so buy-and-dump loops earn nothing.","capabilities":["beforeSwap","onTransfer"],"conflictGroups":[],"needsRouter":true,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"(address rewardToken,uint128 rewardPerBuy,uint128 minBuy,uint16 maxPerWallet,uint32 lockSeconds)","params":[{"key":"rewardToken","label":"Reward token (ERC-20)","type":"address","unit":"address","default":""},{"key":"rewardPerBuy","label":"Reward per buy (reward token's smallest units)","type":"uint128","unit":"int","min":"1","default":"1000000000000000000","help":"Raw units: 1e18 = 1 token for an 18-decimal token, 1e6 = 1 USDC."},{"key":"minBuy","label":"Min buy to earn","type":"uint128","unit":"quote","min":"1","defaultUsd":20,"step":0.1},{"key":"maxPerWallet","label":"Rewarded buys per wallet (0 = no limit)","type":"uint16","unit":"int","min":0,"max":65535,"default":3},{"key":"lockSeconds","label":"Reward lock (forfeited if the buyer sells or sends sooner)","type":"uint32","unit":"hours","min":0,"max":2592000,"default":86400}]},"views":{"vault":"vault(address token) returns (address rewardToken, uint256 balance, uint256 owed, uint256 free, uint256 rewardPerBuy, uint256 minBuy)","owedTo":"owedTo(address token, address wallet) returns (uint256 owed, uint256 rewardedBuys, uint256 locked, uint256 unlockAt)"},"actions":{"fund":"fund(address token, uint256 amount)","claim":"claim(address token, address to) returns (uint256)","withdraw":"withdraw(address token, uint256 amount, address to)"},"events":["Funded(address indexed token, address indexed from, uint256 amount)","Rewarded(address indexed token, address indexed buyer, uint256 amount)","Claimed(address indexed token, address indexed buyer, address to, uint256 amount)","Withdrawn(address indexed token, address to, uint256 amount)","Forfeited(address indexed token, address indexed wallet, uint256 amount)"],"notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (see config/hookModules.ts ParamUnit). fund needs an ERC-20 approval to the module; only the creator may withdraw."}

{"id":"dump-guard","name":"Dump guard","contract":"DumpGuardModule","category":"protection","line":"No transaction sells more than a slice of supply, early on.","detail":"For a window after the pool opens, one transaction can sell at most a share of the 1B supply into the pool, router or aggregator alike. Several sells in one transaction count together. Large holders can still exit, in steps. This rule can refuse sells. Runs twice: for the window after the launch on the bonding curve (curve sells), and again after the pool opens.","capabilities":["beforeSwap","blocksSells"],"conflictGroups":["sellCap"],"needsRouter":false,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"(uint32 dumpBlocks,uint16 maxSellBps)","params":[{"key":"dumpBlocks","label":"Window (blocks)","type":"uint32","unit":"blocks","min":1,"max":43200,"default":1800,"step":1},{"key":"maxSellBps","label":"Max per transaction (% of supply)","type":"uint16","unit":"supplyBps","min":1,"max":1000,"default":50,"step":0.01}]},"views":{"maxSell":"maxSell(bytes32 poolId) returns (uint256 cap, bool active)"},"v1Block":"dumpGuard","notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (as config/hookBlocks.ts). Module buy-side credits of a pool together are capped by the core at 25% of a buy (MAX_MODULE_CUT_BPS): the UI must keep the sum of snipe tax, pot shares, LP rewards, referral fee and King fee under it, or guarded buys revert."}

{"id":"entangled","name":"Entangled","contract":"EntangledModule","category":"linked","line":"Locked until another token's market cap reaches a target, then free forever.","detail":"The pool is locked, no buys and no sells, until the beacon token (launched earlier with the Beacon rule) first reaches the target US-dollar market cap. From then on it trades freely, forever. As a safety valve it unlocks anyway once the maximum lock time after launch has passed, so holders can never be stuck for good. The bonding curve is locked too, so the token graduates only after it unlocks (a dev buy at launch fails while locked). Wallet-to-wallet transfers are never restricted. The beacon's high only counts once its market cap has held for at least 15 minutes across 5 or more blocks, so a quick pump can't unlock it.","capabilities":["beforeSwap","blocksSells"],"conflictGroups":["sellLock"],"needsRouter":false,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"(address beaconToken,uint64 targetUsd,uint32 maxLock)","params":[{"key":"beaconToken","label":"Beacon token (launched with Beacon)","type":"address","unit":"address","default":""},{"key":"targetUsd","label":"Unlocks at beacon market cap (USD)","type":"uint64","unit":"int","min":1000,"max":1000000000000,"default":1000000},{"key":"maxLock","label":"Unlocks anyway after launch (days)","type":"uint32","unit":"days","min":3600,"max":31536000,"default":604800,"step":0.5}]},"views":{"status":"status(address token) returns (bool unlocked, uint256 athUsd, uint256 targetUsd, uint256 unlocksAt)","findBeacon":"findBeacon(address beaconToken) returns (address)"},"events":["Unlocked(address indexed token, address indexed beaconToken, uint256 beaconAthUsd, bool byTimeout)"],"errors":["Locked(uint256 athUsd, uint256 targetUsd, uint256 unlocksAt)","NoBeacon()"],"notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (see config/hookModules.ts ParamUnit). targetUsd is whole US dollars; the views return 18-decimal USD. Launch reverts with NoBeacon unless beaconToken's pool runs the Beacon module."}

{"id":"hot-potato","name":"Hot potato","contract":"HotPotatoModule","category":"sell-lock","line":"The last big buyer can't sell until someone else buys after them.","detail":"Whoever made the last qualifying buy holds the potato: they can't sell or send a single token until a different wallet makes a qualifying buy after them, or until the cool-off (1 hour to 7 days) runs out, so nobody is locked for good. A qualifying buy is a curve buy or a pool buy through the AvaxHook router (so the buyer is known) and receives at least the minimum share of supply. Nobody is exempt, the creator included. Receiving tokens is always fine. It applies on the bonding curve too (where every buyer is known), and the last curve buyer still holds the potato when the pool opens. Buys from aggregators can't be attributed: by default they neither take the potato nor free its holder; with 'Refuse unknown buyers' they are refused, so every buyer can be handed the potato.","capabilities":["afterSwap","onTransfer","blocksSells"],"conflictGroups":["sellLock"],"needsRouter":true,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"(uint16 minBuyBps,uint32 coolOff,bool refuseUnknownBuyers)","params":[{"key":"minBuyBps","label":"Buy that passes the potato (% of supply)","type":"uint16","unit":"supplyBps","min":1,"max":1000,"default":1,"step":0.01},{"key":"coolOff","label":"Holder freed anyway after (minutes)","type":"uint32","unit":"minutes","min":3600,"max":604800,"default":3600,"step":1},{"key":"refuseUnknownBuyers","label":"Refuse buys not made through AvaxHook","type":"bool","unit":"bool","default":false}]},"views":{"potato":"potato(address token) returns (address holder, uint256 since, uint256 freeAt)","minBuy":"minBuy(address token) returns (uint256)","canSell":"canSell(address token, address wallet) returns (bool)"},"events":["PotatoPassed(address indexed token, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount)"],"errors":["PotatoHeld(address holder, uint256 freeAt)","RouterBuysOnly()"],"notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (see config/hookModules.ts ParamUnit)."}

{"id":"king-of-the-hill","name":"King of the Hill","contract":"KingOfTheHillModule","category":"rewards","line":"The biggest buy wears the crown and earns from every trade.","detail":"The largest qualifying single buy holds the crown. A challenger must beat the King's buy by the set margin to steal it, and that bar halves every decay period so the crown keeps moving. While crowned, the King earns a share of every buy and sell in the quote asset, claimable any time. Selling or sending any tokens gives the crown up. Only buys through the AvaxHook router can win it; the creator can't be King unless allowed.","capabilities":["beforeSwap","afterSwap","onTransfer"],"conflictGroups":["crown"],"needsRouter":true,"phase":"pool","config":{"abi":"(uint128 minCrownBuy,uint16 beatBps,uint16 kingFeeBps,uint32 decayPeriod,bool creatorCanBeKing)","params":[{"key":"minCrownBuy","label":"Min buy to take the crown","type":"uint128","unit":"quote","min":"1","defaultUsd":50,"step":0.1},{"key":"beatBps","label":"Beat the King by (%)","type":"uint16","unit":"bps","min":1,"max":10000,"default":500,"step":0.5},{"key":"kingFeeBps","label":"King's share of every trade (%)","type":"uint16","unit":"bps","min":1,"max":200,"default":50,"step":0.05},{"key":"decayPeriod","label":"Bar halves every (minutes, 0 = never)","type":"uint32","unit":"minutes","min":60,"max":31536000,"zeroAllowed":true,"default":21600,"step":1},{"key":"creatorCanBeKing","label":"Creator can be King","type":"bool","unit":"bool","default":false}]},"views":{"currentKing":"currentKing(address token) returns (address king, uint256 winningBuy, uint256 bar, uint256 since)","requiredToCrown":"requiredToCrown(address token) returns (uint256)"},"events":["Crowned(address indexed token, address indexed king, uint256 amount, uint256 timestamp)","Dethroned(address indexed token, address indexed king, uint8 reason)","KingPaid(address indexed token, address indexed king, uint256 amount)"],"notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (as config/hookBlocks.ts). Dethroned reason: 1 beaten, 2 sold, 3 transferred."}

{"id":"last-buyer-pot","name":"Last-buyer pot","contract":"LastBuyerPotModule","category":"rewards","line":"If nobody buys for a while, the last buyer wins.","detail":"A share of each buy fills a pot. Every qualifying buy through the AvaxHook router restarts the clock and takes the lead. When the clock runs out, the leader takes the whole pot (paid at the next qualifying buy or by anyone calling settle) and a new round starts. A pot nobody leads goes to the creator after 30 days. Curve buys fill the pot and lead too. If the module is ever disabled, its funds go to the creator.","capabilities":["beforeSwap"],"conflictGroups":[],"needsRouter":true,"phase":"curve+pool","config":{"abi":"(uint16 potBps,uint32 timerSeconds,uint96 minBuy)","params":[{"key":"potBps","label":"Share of each buy (%)","type":"uint16","unit":"bps","min":1,"max":1000,"default":100,"step":0.1},{"key":"timerSeconds","label":"Clock (minutes)","type":"uint32","unit":"minutes","min":60,"max":604800,"default":1800,"step":1},{"key":"minBuy","label":"Min buy to lead","type":"uint96","unit":"quote","min":"1","defaultUsd":5,"step":0.1}]},"views":{"potOf":"potOf(bytes32 poolId) returns (tuple)","endsAt":"endsAt(bytes32 poolId) returns (uint256)","settle":"settle(bytes32 poolId)"},"events":["NewLeader(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed leader, uint256 endsAt)","TimerPotWon(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed winner, uint256 amount)"],"v1Block":"timerPot","notes":"Values are raw contract units; `unit` says how the UI shows them (as config/hookBlocks.ts). {"id":"market-hours","name":"Market hours","contract":"MarketHoursModule","category":"schedule","family":"market-hours","variant":"all-closed","line":"Trades only while Wall Street is open. After hours, nothing trades.","detail":"Trades are accepted only while the US stock market is open: Monday to Friday, 9:30 am to 4:00 pm New York time, with daylight saving worked out on-chain. Optionally closed on NYSE holidays and closing at 1 pm on early-close days (built-in table for 2026–2030). Every trade keeps these hours: on the bonding curve and in the pool, through the AvaxHook router or any aggregator. A dev buy at launch outside the session fails. {"id":"momentum","name":"Momentum","contract":"MomentumModule","category":"buy-cap","line":"Every buy kicks a spring that sets how big the next buy can be.","detail":"The largest buy allowed rides a damped oscillator.
